name: Cadmium
what_is: A heavy metal environmental contaminant that accumulates in the body.
why_botia: Cadmium can build up in the body and stay for years. Low iron stores can increase absorption. That is an individual susceptibility factor, not a rule that applies to all women.
can_1: Identify raw food ingredients with high cadmium accumulation risks.
can_2: Explain that low iron can increase cadmium uptake. A food label cannot reveal someone's iron status or absorption rate, and sex is not a substitute for either.
cannot_1: Measure the actual concentration in the finished product through label OCR.
cannot_2: Confirm compliance with European maximum levels without chemical analysis.
